title.en: Ground motion, line of sight (COMET LiCSBAS)
title.ja: 地表変位・衛星視線方向(COMET LiCSBAS)

properties.value: mean line-of-sight velocity, mm/yr x 10 (Int16; nodata -32768); positive = toward the satellite

layers.attribution: COMET LiCSBAS (processed by COMET, University of Leeds; not by Plumes); LiCSAR contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2014–2026. CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)

note.en: Mean ground velocity along the satellite's line of sight over each frame's whole span, not a hazard map. Ascending and descending frames see the same ground differently; neither is uplift or subsidence by itself. Grey = no measurable motion. Processed by COMET, not by Plumes. Fixture: the Taal frame 032D only.
note.ja: 各フレームの全期間における衛星視線方向の平均変位速度で、ハザードマップではない。北行と南行の軌道では同じ地表の見え方が異なり、どちらもそれだけで隆起や沈降とは言えない。灰色は測定できる動きがないことを示す。解析はCOMETによる(Plumesではない)。フィクスチャはタールの032Dフレームのみ。
